en.t: In this way I lost confidence once again.

units.source_text: 不管柏木是怎样的想法，女子爱上了柏木没有察觉到的美，

en.t: Whatever Kashiwagi may have thought, the woman had fallen in love with a beauty that Kashiwagi himself had not noticed,

units.source_text: 可我觉得女子对于我的傲慢劲儿也不是一点儿都没有察觉到，我的傲慢劲儿，只有使我自己拒绝了那种美的存在。

en.t: but I felt that the woman had also sensed at least something of my arrogance, and that arrogance had only made me reject the existence of that beauty myself.
